thread.text:
Hi Sanngesh,

I want to be clear about where we are. Our last two support requests took over a week to get a response, and another vendor has offered us a regulatory change feed at a lower price. Before I take the renewal to our board, I need the ROI summary we discussed and a clear view of what changes on support. Can we put 30 minutes in the diary this week?

Marcus

Hi Sanngesh,

We think a former contractor may have exported our policy library after their access should have been revoked. I need the audit log of exports for the last 30 days as soon as possible, ideally today. Who should we work with on your side?

Nadia
Thanks for Friday. Could you send the export workaround steps in writing? My analyst wants to start on the board report first thing Monday.

Hello,

We're starting the renewal paperwork for Cardamon. Could you send a usage summary for the last 12 months by next Friday?

Thanks,
Vela Bank Procurement

Hi Sanngesh, no rush on this - does Cardamon cover the MiCA Title III asset-referenced token obligations? We're planning next quarter's roadmap.
Do you support Okta SCIM provisioning? We want to onboard 15 more users.
Good question - let me check with engineering and come back to you by Monday.
Hi, any update on SCIM? We'd like to start provisioning tomorrow.
Heads up - Vela Bank pinged while you were out and I told them you'd send the updated DORA obligations mapping by end of day today. Sorry to commit you! Draft is in the shared drive.
Can you pull adoption numbers for Kestrel Wealth (active users, obligations mapped)? Prepping their expansion proposal for Thursday.
The PSD3 ingestion fix for Orbitpay passed QA and is live in prod.
Nice. Sanngesh, can you let Orbitpay know? They've been waiting two weeks.
Thanks for the training session yesterday - the team found it really useful!
